stories.title: Birla Opus Paints promotes proactive waterproofing
stories.summary: Birla Opus Paints has launched a campaign for its Alldry range, built around the thought that homeowners should waterproof before damage occurs. The campaign features actors Vikrant Massey and Jagapathi Babu. It aims to move beyond traditional narratives by encouraging proactive decision-making for home maintenance.

stories.title: Godrej Properties launches Diwali campaign
stories.summary: Godrej Properties has released a digital-first Diwali campaign titled Khushiyon Ki Chaabi, Mera Godrej Ghar. The campaign positions the home as a central setting for family memories and festive celebrations. It highlights the idea that happiness is subjective, but the home remains the common denominator.

stories.title: Swiss Beauty targets festive makeup concerns
stories.summary: Swiss Beauty has launched a festive campaign featuring Taapsee Pannu to address consumer anxiety regarding makeup longevity during celebrations. The brand promises to handle makeup performance so customers can remain immersed in the moment. The campaign uses a 90s soundtrack to connect performance with confidence.

stories.title: Samsung Galaxy film focuses on festive connections
stories.summary: Samsung has released a festive brand film for its Galaxy smartphones, created by Cheil India. The campaign centers on the idea that technology helps maintain family connections through shared digital moments. The story follows a group chat that eventually leads to an unexpected physical reunion.

stories.title: Himalaya BabyCare launches winter skincare campaign
stories.summary: Himalaya BabyCare has introduced a winter campaign titled Pehle Winter Ka Pehla Layer. The brand aims to guide parents through winter skincare decisions, addressing common concerns like product allergies and routine changes. It suggests that a proper winter care routine begins with the right first layer.

stories.title: Tilda targets travelers with airport campaign
stories.summary: Premium rice brand Tilda has launched its Feel Home with Tilda campaign at airports in Delhi and Toronto. Timed for the festive season, the campaign targets students and professionals flying home. It is built on the insight that homecomings are closely tied to memories of regional kitchens.

stories.title: KitKat campaign finds humor in festive chaos
stories.summary: VML India has created a festive campaign for KitKat that highlights the minor mishaps and stress associated with holiday preparations. The brand suggests that taking a quick pause can help lighten the festive experience. The campaign frames these inevitable disruptions as part of the celebration.

stories.title: Brands seek relevance in mythological cinema
stories.summary: As Indian cinema explores stories rooted in mythology and folklore, brands are seeking ways to integrate products into historical narratives. With films like Ramayana: Part One releasing, marketers are moving beyond simple product placements to find ways to own moments within these non-contemporary stories.

stories.title: Swiggy rebrands as Sweety for Diwali
stories.summary: Food delivery platform Swiggy has adopted the name Sweety across social media and print advertisements ahead of Diwali. The campaign, which includes the slogan Oh Sweety, ghar aana, promotes its sweets delivery service. The company has modified its logo and social media bio to reflect the change.

stories.title: Nutraj marks 100 years with Diwali campaign
stories.summary: Nutraj has unveiled its Diwali 2026 campaign, What's Your Wish, to mark its 100th year. The brand, founded in 1926, claims to have played a pioneering role in organizing the Indian dry fruits industry. The campaign features celebrity partnerships and emotional storytelling to celebrate the milestone.

stories.title: Swiss Beauty campaign highlights makeup performance
stories.summary: Swiss Beauty has launched a festive campaign featuring Taapsee Pannu to position makeup performance as central to consumer confidence. The campaign addresses the concern of maintaining makeup during long celebrations. It encourages consumers to enjoy festive moments without worrying about their appearance staying intact.

stories.title: Asian Paints highlights festive home preparations
stories.summary: Asian Paints has launched a Diwali campaign titled Taiyyari Shuru, Tyohaar Shuru. The musical film focuses on home cleaning, painting, and decoration as essential parts of the festive season. It presents these tasks as shared experiences that contribute to the overall excitement of the festival.

stories.title: Omnicom Media India tops RECMA report
stories.summary: Omnicom Media India has been ranked number one among media agency groups in the 2026 RECMA Diagnostic Report. The report evaluates media agencies based on various performance metrics. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Triveni Power Transmission wins design award
stories.summary: Triveni Power Transmission Limited has won a Silver award in the Website Branding category at the 2026 MUSE Creative Awards. The website was developed following the company's 2026 demerger to establish a distinct identity. It was selected from more than 5,000 global submissions.

stories.title: Signpost India reports flat profit growth
stories.summary: Signpost India reported a 0.63 percent year-on-year growth in net profit to 15.80 crore rupees for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. The company attributed the performance to a delay in the festive calendar. Lower taxes helped the company sustain its bottom line.

stories.title: Edelman appoints new Japan CEO
stories.summary: Edelman has appointed Campbell Hanley as CEO and representative director of Edelman Japan. He succeeds Meghan Barstow, who is leaving the firm after 20 years. Hanley joins from Omnicom Public Relations, where he served as head of client experience and growth for Asia Pacific.

stories.title: Effectiveness awards examine campaign impact
stories.summary: Effectiveness awards in India are increasingly focusing on how creative ideas change consumer behavior and improve business performance. Unlike creative awards, these evaluate measurable value across diverse markets. Campaigns are often required to build awareness and drive results simultaneously in a complex digital and linguistic landscape.

stories.title: Wipro Consumer Care selects Hypothesis
stories.summary: Wipro Consumer Care has appointed Hypothesis to manage its social media and influencer marketing efforts. The agency will oversee the brand's digital engagement strategies. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: TBWA Lintas wins Starbucks India creative account
stories.summary: TBWA Lintas has been awarded the integrated creative mandate for Starbucks India following a multi-agency pitch. The agency will manage digital and creative communication as the brand targets a cafe market projected to reach USD 1.1 billion by 2034. Coffee culture is expanding across the country.

stories.title: Instagram offers creators up to $500,000 for long-form video
stories.summary: Meta is offering creators up to $500,000 to bring long-form content to Instagram. The platform is introducing a 90-minute video feature called Features to challenge YouTube. The company is attempting to pivot its creator economy away from its traditional focus on short-form content and photographs.

stories.title: Facebook expands Creator Fast Track program to Brazil
stories.summary: Meta is expanding its Creator Fast Track program to Brazil, offering guaranteed monthly payments to creators who move their content to Facebook. To qualify, creators must have 20,000 followers on other platforms and 30,000 video views in the last month. The company wants more content posted.

stories.title: Meta outlines US$97.5 billion AI financing plan
stories.summary: Meta has announced a financing plan of up to US$97.5 billion to support its artificial intelligence ambitions. The company claims this infrastructure will improve the economics of its advertising business. Advertisers are waiting to see if the investment results in more than just internal infrastructure improvements.

stories.title: Brands struggle to measure ROI from AI search visibility
stories.summary: Agencies are building tools to track brand appearances in AI chatbots like ChatGPT as search marketers prioritize AI visibility. A survey of small and medium businesses found 56 percent cite measuring return on investment as their top challenge. The industry currently lacks standardization for tracking these results.

stories.title: OpenAI faces conversion challenges with ChatGPT advertising
stories.summary: ChatGPT now handles roughly 20 percent of the search queries Google processes, but its advertising business remains significantly smaller. OpenAI only began selling ads this year and is currently navigating how to integrate them without alienating users. Advertising is currently lagging behind total platform usage.

stories.title: DoorDash bid for Instacart sparks commerce media consolidation talk
stories.summary: Media buyers and analysts are discussing industry consolidation following DoorDash’s $17 billion bid to acquire Instacart. Industry experts suggest commerce media is following the path of search and social markets by consolidating around a few major players. The deal remains subject to the usual regulatory scrutiny.

stories.title: Meta updates Graph and Marketing APIs
stories.summary: Meta has released Graph API v27.0 and Marketing API v27.0. The update enables two features by default for new ads, blocks six legacy features for new apps, and disables the catalog batch endpoint. Older versions will be removed throughout 2027. Code is now required to keep up.

stories.title: Reddit publishes 2027 marketing playbook
stories.summary: Reddit has released a 35-page guide for 2027 planning. The document highlights the platform's influence on product discovery and shopping insights, while providing a list of major events to help brands maximize engagement. The calendar is now the primary focus of the company's planning advice.

stories.title: TikTok says AI micro-dramas are legal
stories.summary: AI-generated micro-dramas featuring explicit themes are appearing on children's feeds. TikTok maintains that the content is legal. These clips originate from a $14 billion industry that floods social media with short-form videos. The internet is currently being populated by soap opera slop with zero regulation.

stories.title: Wurl explores scene-level targeting for CTV
stories.summary: Wurl is promoting scene-level targeting to help CTV advertisers align creative with onscreen context. While streaming services see a surge in popularity, advertisers report an opaque ecosystem and ad fill rates that are failing to keep pace. The biggest screen in the home remains difficult to navigate.

stories.title: Reddit tests search result ads
stories.summary: Reddit is testing ad placements within its search results. The company claims users seek human perspectives they cannot find elsewhere, with half of its users reporting that the platform helps them discover new things. The ads will be targeted by query and marked as sponsored content.

stories.title: LinkedIn details creator analytics updates
stories.summary: LinkedIn has updated its profile insights dashboard to provide more data on content performance and monetization. The new Post Performance Table displays key metrics to help creators maximize in-app opportunities. The platform is providing more ways to measure what is working and what is not.

stories.title: Meta ends support for Quest 2 and Quest Pro
stories.summary: Meta will stop feature development for Quest 2 and Quest Pro headsets by March 2027. The company launched the devices to support a metaverse vision centered on VR connection. Meta has since shifted its primary attention to generative artificial intelligence. The next stage is glasses.

stories.title: Reddit pitches gaming communities to brands
stories.summary: Reddit is encouraging brands to target its 1,300 gaming-related communities. Citing TransUnion research, the company claims gaming marketers are failing to capitalize on the engagement within these groups. Reddit says these communities influence discovery and purchasing decisions, provided the brands can find them.

stories.title: Explain Data focuses on campaign tracking
stories.summary: Explain Data is positioning its analytics services around customer-focused metrics and event tracking. The company aims to connect marketing activity to specific actions like purchases and registrations, rather than relying on traffic figures. The brand is focusing on measurements that matter to individual campaigns.

stories.title: Theorem launches partner program for Shopify brands
stories.summary: Theorem has launched a 90-day program for Shopify retailers to access its Upward for D2C solution. Selected brands will work with the company to identify storefront conversion gaps and activate video content. The program offers free access to the platform for the duration of the trial.

stories.title: Festive advertising shifts toward AI intelligence
stories.summary: Connect Network Inc. CEO Haresh Nayak writes that festive advertising is moving from simple visibility to intelligence-led planning. The approach leverages data on location and demographics to inform strategies. Brands are now competing for attention by attempting to understand complex consumer journeys through artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Agencies report AI-driven brief bloat
stories.summary: Agency leaders report that over-reliance on generative AI to write advertising briefs is undermining productivity. M&C Saatchi North American CEO Nadja Bellan-White suggests the trend is approaching a tipping point. The industry is finding itself vulnerable to the toxic byproducts of its own efficiency tools.

stories.title: Dabur establishes digital marketing centers
stories.summary: Dabur is creating Global Capability Centres to enhance its marketing and IT functions. The company is collaborating with Accenture to utilize AI and automation for audience targeting and content intelligence. The goal is to fast-track AI adoption to improve operational efficiency across its various divisions.

stories.title: Dabur discusses digital marketing roadmap
stories.summary: Dabur Global CIO Manas Mehra is discussing the company's framework for building a digital marketing center. The roadmap focuses on taking AI projects from pilot to production. The company is currently working to establish standardized processes for its marketing and IT functions.

stories.title: MarTech explores AI agents in customer experience
stories.summary: The full piece is for subscribers. MarTech examines how AI agents are being deployed to improve customer experience, focusing on the integration of automated systems into existing service frameworks. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Brandweek discusses attribution risks
stories.summary: Generac CMO Amanda Teder discussed the risks of focusing marketing strategy on metrics that are easiest to measure. Teder argued that demand generation is only the opening move in high-consideration categories. Marketing is framed as a connected operating system rather than a series of short-term wins.

stories.title: Friendbuy launches influencer software
stories.summary: Friendbuy has released software for brands to manage influencer and affiliate programs. The platform handles recruitment, onboarding, and automated payouts without requiring brands to hand data to a marketplace. It is designed to work alongside existing referral and loyalty programs to track repeat customer purchases.

stories.title: Supermetrics integrates Claude into marketing workflows
stories.summary: Supermetrics has expanded its AI capabilities by allowing users to analyze and edit campaigns using Claude. More than 6,000 customers have used the integration since February. The company claims active users are growing by 250% month over month, making it a fast-adopted product launch.

stories.title: Food influencer Sober Facts addresses conflict with N.O.R.E.
stories.summary: Food influencer Jason Rodriguez, known as Sober Facts, says he will apologize to rapper N.O.R.E. following a public confrontation regarding his use of the N-word. Rodriguez says he respects the rapper's request to stop filming. The influencer maintains his criticisms of substance use on the show.

stories.title: WhisperAI reports record transcription volume
stories.summary: WhisperAI processed 144,688 hours of audio and video in October, a sevenfold increase since January. The company credits automation and expanded meeting assistant features for the growth. It now claims 460,000 users across 125 countries. The platform remains independently operated and bootstrapped.
